text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen. A
while has
passed since our setback at
the Mainichi Okan,
but Эль Кондор Паса is
set to make an amazing
comeback.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса declares to Silence
Suzuka that
she'll beat her, even if she
doesn't have what it
takes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Сайленс Судзука quietly remarks
that El
Condor Pasa possesses a power
that she herself
does not.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That said, she has no intention of losing.
The
clash between these two
competitive souls...
begin now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
